sources.assertion: Public terms reserve Fees but do not publish an applicable numeric issuer redemption tariff.

sources.location: Prerequisites
sources.excerpt: Ensure you have sufficient XRP or ETH in your wallet(s) to cover the network fees required for redemptions.
sources.assertion: Network fees are acknowledged; this is not an issuer-fee schedule or complete same-notional cost bound.

entries.rationale: The exact offchain-issuer RLUSD cost remains unquantified: public User Terms expressly reserve Fees and direct customers to a separate Customer Agreement, while issuer redemption docs, whitepaper, report archive and NYDFS guidance disclose no applicable numeric issuer tariff or complete all-in same-notional fee formula. Public network gas mechanics do not disclose that missing issuer charge.

sources.location: Sections 11.4.3 and 11.5
sources.excerpt: You are responsible for delivery and once your bars are in the possession of the delivery service you choose, then Paxos will have been deemed to have fulfilled its obligation for delivery.
sources.assertion: Physical gold redemption defines handoff to the customer-selected carrier, but no maximum for issuer bar release or completed delivery is stated.

entries.rationale: The exact captured offchain-issuer route outputs physical commodity:xau, not bank USD. Public terms section 11.4 require at least 430 PAXG per bar and customer-arranged delivery, with issuer delivery obligation fulfilled at carrier handoff; section 11.5 offers commercially reasonable efforts and several business days without a binding maximum. Product, whitepaper, dashboard guide, reserve archive and support surfaces publish no end-to-end maximum for this physical-gold channel. Fiat wire guidelines cannot answer it.

sources.location: Exhibit B, page 6
sources.excerpt: The Company purchases their gold from StoneX Group Inc., a company registered in England and Wales (StoneX).
sources.assertion: Full allocated-gold quantity and sourcing/vault institutions are disclosed, not a whole-position USD realization horizon.

sources.location: Section 11.5
sources.excerpt: Paxos will make commercially reasonable efforts to convert and/or redeem your PAXG quickly.
sources.assertion: Customer conversion effort is not a guaranteed realization horizon for the entire reserve gold position.

entries.rationale: The exact whole-slice liquidityHorizon for allocated reserve gold is undisclosed. The full August gold inventory, vault/source identities, whitepaper, terms, dashboard docs, product FAQ and redemption/wire help disclose ownership and customer conversion mechanisms but no funded or enforceable time bound to realize the entire scoped gold position into USD. Instant token transfer, indicative quotes and market-wide gold volume cannot establish immediate whole-book liquidity.

sources.location: USDC Reserve Report pp.2-5, reserve criteria and bank balances
sources.excerpt: Segregated Accounts are unencumbered accounts held on behalf of USDC holders that are segregated from other accounts of Circle, including general corporate funds.
sources.assertion: Treasury maturity dates and overnight repo term are disclosed separately; bank cash and net settlement adjustments have no stated maximum contractual term.

entries.rationale: The exact missing datum is maturityDaysMax for Cash at Regulated Financial Institutions (net settlement adjustments). The current signed report and transparency archive identify bank cash and settlement adjustments, and the legal terms explain segregated USD-denominated reserves. None supplies account contracts or a maximum term applying to every claim in this scoped bank-deposit slice. Published Treasury maturity dates and overnight repo maturities cannot be transferred to bank claims; holder redemption at par is not deposit maturity.
